title: Sales Call Recording to CRM Pipeline Automation
summary: Every discovery and sales call is recorded, classified and turned into an up-to-date CRM opportunity automatically.
headline: Every sales call lands in your CRM
problem: Call outcomes, pricing discussions and objections were not reliably making it into the CRM.
solution: When a call finishes in Fathom, a Zapier flow updates the contact in GoHighLevel. A CRM automation then creates or updates the opportunity, and an n8n workflow classifies the call as discovery or sales and records the lead status, pricing and objections in Supabase.
highlights: Calls from Fathom synced to the CRM automatically
Split by call type and call length
Opportunities created and updated without data entry
Outcomes, pricing and objections stored for reporting
role: Sole engineer. I designed the pipeline across all four tools and built every automation in it.

results.label: No call data lost between recording and CRM
Accurate pipeline stages and lead accountability
